summary: Defines two new IPv4 Options used only with the Identifier-Locator Network Protocol for IPv4 (ILNPv4), an experimental, evolutionary enhancement to IP. It comes from the IRTF Routing Research Group and defines an Experimental Protocol.

eli5.summary: An IPv4 packet has room for extra labels. This memo adds two special labels that only ILNP uses. It is only an experiment.

questions: what ip options does ilnp use
